leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply event handler functions to respond to user interactions in React components.
Implement TypeScript type annotations for event parameters to ensure type safety.
Use the onClick prop to handle click events on button elements.
Define inline arrow functions to pass event handlers directly to JSX elements.
Construct controlled input components by handling onChange events.
Utilize event objects to access target values from form inputs.
Assign state variables to store and update data based on user events.
Invoke setState functions within event handlers to trigger UI updates.
Handle form submission events to prevent default browser behavior.
Control component behavior by passing event handlers as props to child components.
Modify component state based on multiple event types within a single component.
Return appropriate JSX structures that include event handlers for interactive elements.
